# UC16b — Raw user-token forwarding blocked (Zero Trust)

**Track:** attacks  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T9 · Sections: §4.1.1

## Buyer Story

The agent must never hold or forward the user's raw access token — only scoped, exchanged agent tokens may leave the BFF.

## PingOne Solution

The BFF performs RFC 8693 token exchange and enforces ff_skip_token_exchange fail-closed: an attempt to resolve a tool token by raw user-token forwarding is blocked with 403 user_token_forwarding_disabled at the source.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Attack simulation: `raw-user-token-forwarding`  
**Expected outcome:** `DENY_403`

## What to Say

> The agent tried to hand MCP the user's own token — the BFF refused to forward it. Only exchanged, agent-scoped tokens with an act claim ever leave the BFF. Zero Trust.

## Evidence

**Token chain steps:** user-token → exchange-skipped  
**Activity categories:** token
